listenings.text: Hello, I am Mike, and today I have three tips for your business on Instagram. First, post often. I usually post four times a week, and I never stop for a long time. Second, write a good caption. A short caption is always better than a long caption. Third, talk to your followers. I always answer comments in the morning, and I sometimes share photos from my clients. Your brand is not only your product. Your brand is the way you talk to people. Good luck!

Hi everyone, I am Sofia. I sell private jets in Texas, and Instagram is a big part of my business. I post a new video every Tuesday and every Friday. I usually film the aircraft at the airport in the morning, because the light is beautiful. I sometimes post photos of happy clients, but I always ask them first. I never post prices on Instagram. When a follower is interested, I send a message, and we talk. Last year, three of my clients found me on Instagram.

extra_audio.text: First, Karina films a new video of the aircraft. Then, she writes a short caption in English. Next, she posts the video on Monday morning. After that, followers write comments and share the video. Finally, Karina answers every comment.
